db_validation_expectations: Count distinct source-live CPT animals considered for the discussed ET+TT/PPR validation: 324.

Seed must use the committed cpt-operator-roster.json as-is: Amit Friday-off, Darshan Sunday-off, Sagar Saturday-off; all three must have vaccination_operator_shift_config rows and a 200 animal/day cap.
Do not validate with a throwaway roster override that removes Amit or changes Sagar's week-off.
Clean reseed schedule proof must run before any leave/cascade mutation test, or in a separate disposable DB.
With N=1/default Darshan and ET+TT only on 2026-07-24, no ET+TT drive row may be assigned to Amit or Sagar.
With N=1/default Darshan and PPR moved to 2026-08-07, no PPR drive row may appear on 2026-07-24 or 2026-07-25.
For any row where ET+TT and PPR happen together, animal capacity remains the distinct animal count; doses may be double but capacity must not double.
Darshan is available on Friday and Saturday; his weekly off is Sunday.
No planned date/operator may exceed 200 distinct animals when active_operators_per_day=1.
Do not use superseded batches or batches with zero attached obligation_instances as schedule proof.
Report non-ET+TT/PPR vaccine obligations separately by dose_code, planned_date, operator, and distinct animal count.
